settings.question: How big is it?
settings.answer: 80.5 mm wide and 3 mm thick, just under the width of a credit card. The height depends on the car.

settings.question: What comes with it?
settings.answer: The keychain, a split ring and a short chain.

settings.question: Why is there no badge on the front?
settings.answer: Logos and emblems belong to the car makers, so every Grille Talk design is logo-free. The shape, the lights and the grille do the talking.

settings.question: Which body colors can I pick?
settings.answer: White, matte red, matte yellow, matte gray, matte blue and metallic silver. The lights stay white and the details stay black whichever you pick.

settings.question: My car isn't here. Can you make it?
settings.answer: Send it through the request form. More cars are already in the works.

What's on the back?
settings.answer: A woven carbon-fibre finish from the textured build plate, with GRILLE TALK across it in white lettering.

settings.question: Can I change the headlight color?
settings.answer: Yes. White is standard; red, yellow, gray, blue or silver headlights are a small extra, shown on each product page.

settings.title: The light signature
settings.text: Traced from the real car and printed in white, so the DRLs read like they are switched on.

settings.title: Grille texture
settings.text: Slats and mesh are raised in relief, not printed flat. Catch it in the light and the grille has depth.

settings.title: Intakes and body lines
settings.text: Engraved grooves around half a millimetre deep pick out the intakes and the lines across the bumper.

settings.title: Tab, ring and chain
settings.text: A keyring tab on the left with a 4.5 mm hole. A jump ring goes through it, then a short chain and a split ring.

settings.title: Carbon-fibre back
settings.text: Printed face-down on a carbon-fibre build plate, so the back picks up a woven carbon finish, with GRILLE TALK across it in white.

settings.title: Start from the real car
settings.text: Every design begins as a straight-on photo of the car's front, cropped at the windshield and traced line by line.

settings.title: Keep what owners notice
settings.text: Light signature, grille, intakes, body lines. Everything else goes, badges included. The shape does the talking.

settings.title: Two colours, one print
settings.text: A black base under a white or colored cap, printed together on a carbon-fibre plate. The lights stay white, or pick a custom headlight color.

settings.title: Ready for your keys
settings.text: A jump ring through the tab, a short chain and a split ring. Clip it on and it is yours.

settings.label: Mounting
settings.value: Double-sided tape recommended, or two countersunk screw holes (tape and screws not included)
